item.title: Fixture Infotech CSR: digital skilling programme to train 2,000 Pune youth
item.description: Fixture Infotech will train 2,000 young people in Pune through its CSR digital skilling programme, the company said.

item.title: Fixture Infotech CSR to plant 10,000 trees in Pune
item.description: Fixture Infotech announced a separate CSR environmental programme to plant trees. The CSR foundation's education work continues.
